publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: English UI and a physical selector
record.method: Separate QEMU frame replay and physical UART/consumer-delivery capture
record.observation: The October 3 selector defaults to 3.1.3 after 12 seconds. Physical display, Home and Z2 consumer paths execute; the injected slider contacts are synthetic. English lock/home captures belong to QEMU.
record.limits: The original run has no panel photograph or human-finger observation. Later owner acceptance is recorded separately. Marker times are buffered host receipts.

exhibits.title: 7E18 English lock screen in QEMU
exhibits.alt: Actual QEMU 3.1.3 lock-screen capture showing the English slider
exhibits.caption: 7E18 in the partial PinePhone QEMU model, before synthetic unlock. Guest pixels, not a physical panel photograph. The cellular label is not evidence of connectivity.
